text:
[LCNT.6.1] [LCNT.1.3] does not say DS cannot iterate. Genuinely
iterative, imperative, or stateful logic must go out to an adapter — a
`call` to an external service ([LCRS]) —
fenced at that boundary and recorded as facts for deterministic replay.
Iteration happens outside the deterministic core, never inside the rule
language.

A gap in the fixed algebra must be filled either by adding a closed
operation to it ([LCNT.3.1]) or by pushing the work across the adapter
boundary. It must not be filled by opening iteration.
